ModMetaData.name: Better Tradable Items
ModMetaData.author: Coldcrow
ModMetaData.description:
Better Tradable Items fixes the items vanilla won't let you sell, and makes a short list buyable too. It borrows from existing mods that each handle one item (credited in ReadMe.txt) and adds a few I wanted tradable myself.
Now sellable (vanilla would not take them): - Stone and slag chunks. Worth next to nothing, but a ship that buys everything will haul them away - Stone blocks (plus Alpha Memes stone blocks) - Meals - Gravcore (Odyssey), mechanoid transponder (Biotech), void sculpture (Anomaly), animus stone (Royalty) - Toxic wastepacks (Biotech), at a token value, so a ship that buys everything (the Better Orbital Traders scrapyard) will haul them away
Now buyable as well as sellable: - Ambrosia - Healer mech serum - Fish, psilocap, and thrumbomane (Odyssey) - Ghoul resurrection serum (Anomaly)
The resurrector mech serum stays vanilla: sellable, never for sale. Buying resurrection changes the game's rules.
Want something added? Leave a comment on the Workshop page.
Vanilla Gravship Expanded makes the gravcore buyable. With it loaded the gravcore is buyable and sellable both, and this mod loads after it so the two agree.
XML only, RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7, no DLC required, safe to add or remove mid-save.
